text:
tess: Quick UX question — the alert preview's recipient area is getting confusing. header says 'Recipients' but people report not sure if muted channels or escalation policies are included. kevin: I'm seeing this in user tests too. Maybe change header to 'Expected recipients' and add a one-line hint? e.g. 'Who will get notified (in delivery order)'. srini: Keyboard/a11y note: tab order currently jumps into the preview iframe before the recipients list. We should make recipients tabbable before the preview and expose a focusable 'edit recipients' button. aria: Also contrast on the muted badge is low when dimmed. severity pill + muted label fails AA in dark mode. design-bot: :robot_face: Accessibility check — muted pill contrast 2.8:1 (required >= 4.5:1 for small text). kevin: Good catch. Proposal: change muted label to icon + text with higher contrast, and show a tooltip 'muted — notifications suppressed by policy'. tess: I like the 'Expected recipients' header. UX tweak: show a compact stack of recipients with overflow '+N' and on hover expand into full list. For screen readers expand should announce full list. srini: For SR: use aria-label="Expected recipients: 2 channels, 1 escalation policy" and an aria-live region for changes when policy toggles. Also ensure order is spoken: '1: #oncall, 2: PagerDuty, 3: Email'. kevin: Mock notes — I'll update the component: add header copy, inline hint, hover expansion. Will replace muted pill color and add icon. Also add focus ring on list items for keyboard nav. aria: Copy nits: 'delivery order' -> 'notification order' reads clearer. Also 'edit recipients' should be 'Manage recipients' for discoverability. tess: Decision checklist: 1) Header -> 'Expected recipients', 2) Hint text -> 'Notification order shown left-to-right', 3) Expand on hover/focus, 4) Add Manage recipients button (keyboard focusable), 5) Fix muted contrast, 6) SR announce count + ordered list. design-bot: :white_check_mark: Added todo in design board: CARD-1287 Recipient list accessibility + copy. kevin: I'll push a refreshed mock by EOD and include a short screenreader demo snippet. srini: Small code suggestion for aria:
  1. #oncall — primary
  2. PagerDuty — escalation
  3. email-team@example.com
aria: Looks good. Add role="list" and use visually-hidden text for 'notification order' for clarity. tess: Thanks all — will review the updated mock and sign off on copy. :thumbsup:
